answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 32270 Country: India Title: regarding NAMAZ without topi... Question: a) can we offer namaz without wearing cap? is this right? will we get less sawab out of it? is this a complete way to offer namaz? b) is namaz possible wearing t-shirts or half shirts? Answer ID: 32270 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 797/667/B=1432) (1) If one does not wear topi due to humility, humbleness and meekness then salah shall be lawful without being makrooh. But if one offered salah bareheaded due to carelessness and fashion, then it is against etiquette and makrooh, he will receive less rewards. (2) One can offer salah in T-shirt or half shirt, the salah shall be valid but it shall be makrooh if the elbows are open. One should offer salah in the dress of pious persons. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
